plays.title: Call Spreads in Payments Winner in the AI Era
idea: A payments winner in the AI era: +15% YTD and pulled back from highs that stalled at anchored VWAP off the high, forming a cup and handle on the weekly.

Shares hold well above key retracements and anchored VWAP from the low in a bullish trend. A monthly move above $87.5 opens a $100–$120 zone; the 11/3 earnings report lands inside the December window.
Call spreads cut the debit to $3.50 in exchange for capping the gain at the $85 short strike. Exits are set on the stock: a $70 stop and a $90 target.
plays.recommendation: Long XYZ December $75/$85 call spreads at $3.50. Cup-and-handle / AVWAP setup with 11/3 earnings ahead; stock stop $70, stock target $90.
